g.text: Ten monks brought the Abbot ten complaints: the crowded gate, the cancelled ceremony, the
empty storeroom, the weak legs of the old travellers, the exhausted infirmary monks, the
The Abbot heard all ten, then asked one question: "When does a healed traveller learn that he
Many complaints, one cause. A Current Reality Tree is drawn to find it.
If the cause is that plain, why has nobody fixed it?
